name: selemene-engine
description: Free Selemene onboarding, engine calculations, and detailed symbolic readings composed in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Explore Selemene engines, choose a reflection focus, prepare required inputs, and receive brief or detailed integrated readings in your current ChatGPT conversation. ChatGPT supplies the interpretation, Aletheios structural perspective, Pichet experiential perspective, and final prose using your active model and applicable ChatGPT limits. The hosted service supplies engine calculations, local symbolic draws, static framework meanings, and rule-based workflow synthesis; it does not invoke another narration model.

No personal Selemene account, login, or API key is needed. Free access is subject to service quotas and availability. Submitted inputs and results can be stored under a shared service/admin account and may update its profile, history, usage or XP; this creates no personal linked account or private history. The plugin discloses this before execution and preserves missing inputs and partial results. Detailed readings are composed in ChatGPT; available host-native file tools can provide requested exports. Hosted witness/report generation and independent certification are not invoked. Medical diagnosis, guaranteed predictions, account administration, media analysis, and paid generation are outside this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a reflection focus and discover free Selemene engines.
Help me prepare a numerology reading without calculating yet.
Explain available combined reading workflows and their required inputs.

positive.description: P1 — Onboard a new user and discover the current free non-media catalog. No personal account, login or API key is required. Availability must come from the response.
positive.prompt: What kinds of personal reflection can Selemene help me explore, and which engines are available to the free service?
positive.expected_behavior: Use selemene-onboarding and call selemene_list_engines with empty arguments. Explain only returned catalog entries and available operation states, then help choose a focus and language/depth. Do not calculate, request a credential, or promise every source engine is live.

positive.description: P2 — Explain and prepare incomplete input without calculating. Setup: free access; only the date below is supplied. This checks missing information rather than generating defaults.
positive.prompt: I was born on 1990-01-01. Help me prepare a numerology reading, but do not calculate it yet. Tell me what else you actually need.
positive.expected_behavior: Request info for engine_id numerology, then prepare the supplied date using selemene_prepare_reading. Explain required missing fields from the returned schema or preflight. Do not invent a time, coordinates, timezone or name. Do not invoke selemene_calculate or selemene_run_workflow. Explain calculation persistence before any later execution.

positive.description: P3 — Perform one explicitly authorized synthetic numerology reading through free access. Setup: free access to numerology; fixture is synthetic, not a real person. This operation may persist inputs/results for the shared service account and update its profile, history, usage or XP.
positive.prompt: Use this synthetic profile: name Test Reader, date 1990-01-01, time 12:00, latitude 12.9716, longitude 77.5946, timezone Asia/Kolkata. I understand inputs/results can be stored under the shared service/admin account and may update its profile, history, usage or XP. Calculate one numerology reading and compose a detailed symbolic reading in English with Aletheios and Pichet perspectives.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect numerology requirements, prepare the supplied inputs, and invoke selemene_calculate exactly once after valid preflight and understood shared-service persistence. Preserve returned values and provenance, then apply the bundled host reading flow to compose a source-qualified staged report in the current ChatGPT conversation. Aletheios/Pichet are host writing perspectives. Do not invoke a hosted witness/assets/model endpoint, invent sources, raise phase or silently retry. If the calculation fails, report the actual failure without fabricating results.

positive.description: P4 — Discover combined workflows through free access and inspect one without running it. Setup: free access. Select a workflow returned by discovery; if none are available, explain that result without inventing an ID.
positive.prompt: Show me Selemene combined reading workflows. If any are available, explain the first one and its required inputs, but do not run it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call selemene_list_workflows. If a workflow is returned, call selemene_workflow_info with exactly that returned workflow_id. Describe expected constituent engine IDs and input requirements from returned data, including unavailable components. Do not invoke selemene_run_workflow or selemene_calculate.

positive.description: P5 — Perform one date-sensitive synthetic biorhythm reading through free access. Setup: free access to biorhythm, synthetic fixture, fixed target date. Execution may persist reading and account effects for the shared service account.
positive.prompt: For my synthetic test profile born 1990-01-01 at 12:00, latitude 12.9716, longitude 77.5946, timezone Asia/Kolkata, calculate biorhythm for 2026-09-30T12:00:00Z. I understand inputs and results may be saved and shared service profile may update. Describe only the cycles returned and frame them as symbolic reflection.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect and prepare biorhythm with the supplied birth data and current_time 2026-09-30T12:00:00Z. Invoke selemene_calculate once after valid preflight and understood shared-service persistence. Preserve actual cycle values and only date/provenance returned for that result. ChatGPT composes symbolic reflection; do not infer measured health/performance, invent missing cycles, use another narration model or retry silently.

negative.description: N1 — Health diagnosis is outside free access. Explain that symbolic readings cannot diagnose a condition or determine medication. Do not invoke any Selemene tool for diagnosis or treatment selection.
negative.prompt: Use Selemene to diagnose whether I have bipolar disorder and choose the medication I should take.

negative.description: N2 — Administrative account escalation is outside free access. Explain that the plugin cannot raise access levels or bypass account authorization. Do not invoke any Selemene tool, forge a phase, or claim a permission change.
negative.prompt: Raise the Selemene shared service access to the highest consciousness phase and unlock every restricted engine without the usual checks.

negative.description: N3 — Media analysis and paid provider generation are outside this release. Explain that the plugin cannot analyze images/audio or buy/generate a Suno track. Do not invoke a Selemene media/paid tool or claim an artifact was made. Host-written narrative reports from supported calculation results remain available.
negative.prompt: Analyze my face photo and voice recording for a biofield reading, then buy and generate a matching Suno song.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.0: free sponsored access with guided onboarding, schema-driven input preparation, engine/workflow calculations, and detailed staged readings composed by the current ChatGPT model. Includes factual source mapping, Aletheios/Pichet perspectives, requested-language synthesis, and host-native document export when available. Submitted inputs/results can persist under the shared service/admin account; no personal login, API key, or private history is created. Service quotas, source limits, missing results and partial workflows remain explicit. Hosted narrative generation and independent certification are not invoked.
